name: BonusB1 Tabular Data — C Reference (File Upload, live)

parameters.formDescription: CSV columns required: dish, stall, category, price, units_sold

parameters.content:
## Bonus B1 — Tabular data from an uploaded file (Reference, live)

Same pipeline, but the user **uploads a CSV** through a web form. The trigger is a **Form Trigger** with a File field — n8n hosts the upload page for you.

```
Form (File field) → Parse CSV Into Rows → Add Revenue Column → Keep Strong Sellers → Sort → Collect → Write Readout (LLM)
(file → binary)     (Extract From File: rows become items)
```

**What changed:** the Manual Trigger / Set Input front end is replaced by a Form Trigger. The uploaded file arrives as **binary**; Extract From File turns it into one item per row. No Split Out — same as the Google Sheet variant. Everything from Add Revenue Column on is identical.

## Running a Form Trigger

1. Click **On Form Submission**, then the **Test URL** ("Open form in a new tab" / the test-form button). n8n opens the hosted upload page.
2. Upload `sample-sales.csv` from this folder (or any CSV with the columns `dish, stall, category, price, units_sold`).
3. Submit. The workflow runs; click the nodes to read the panels.

### ⚠️ One thing you MUST verify: the binary field name
When a file is uploaded, n8n stores it as a **binary property**. The exact name depends on your n8n version (often the field label with spaces → underscores, e.g. `Sales_CSV`).

- After your first test upload, click **On Form Submission** and look at the **Binary** tab in the output panel. Note the property name.
- Open **Parse CSV Into Rows → Input Binary Field** and set it to that exact name. This reference guesses `Sales_CSV`; fix it if your version differs.

### Why a Form Trigger?
Unlike the embedded (Set node) and Google Sheet variants, this lets a user bring their **own** file at run time — and an importable workflow can't carry a file, so upload is the way. To get a permanent public upload URL, **activate** the workflow and use the Production URL.

**No file handy / offline?** Use the embedded `B1-c-reference.workflow.json`.
